ui.title: Regulatory Return Drafter
ui.tagline: Drafts a periodic regulatory return from the ledger and the regulator's own instructions, checks every line against last period and the validation rules, and files it as a draft only after the compliance officer signs off.

actions.label: Run: Regulatory return drafting
actions.description: For a reporting period, Kaman pulls the ledger balances and the regulator's instructions in parallel, drafts the return, checks it against last period and the validation rules, and puts it in front of the compliance officer before filing it as a draft.

actions.label: Ask the Ledger Analyst
actions.description: Pulls the period's balances and last period's filing from the warehouse.
